justification: Both surfaces show relief-carved human figures with raised arms and what may be a curved handheld implement, and A's upper register also groups figures around a central axis; but A is dominated by a formal, ruled arrangement of a lunette scene above many dense horizontal registers of script signs, an organizing scheme entirely absent from B, which shows only a few large-scale, loosely disposed figures with no framing, no registers and no writing. The correspondence is limited to the generic fact of human figures in relief, which any tradition could produce independently.
